description: WAVE C (launch-critical, FIRST — the user's Excel migration sits on top of this). Baseline verification + make the DB rebuild runnable and documented. Today all 9 mgmt/db/schema/*.sql build clean in fresh sqlite (54 tables) but contain ZERO INSERTs — every seed row lives in migrations OUTSIDE schema/: 28-journey-content (12 rows), 29-journey-page-text (2), 30-donation-settings (7, the bank/UPI details the donate page shows), 32-consent-decline-templates (6, without which a declined consent notifies nobody — the #349 gap). A DB built only from schema/ launches half-empty. DEPLOY_GUIDE.md has NO W8g section despite #367 claiming one. This feature adds a runnable, VERIFIED rebuild procedure (a script + the W8g runbook section) that builds schema then applies the seed rows and asserts the counts. This is independent of Waves A and B and could ship first in parallel.
steps: Establish and record the green baseline on main FIRST (house method): run `cd mgmt/backend && npm test`, `cd mgmt/server-render && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm test`, `cd mgmt/frontend && npm ci && npm run build`, and the SvelteKit checks; capture that everything passes at commit 3cc8529 before any change. Record in the feature findings.

Prove the defect: write a test (node --test, placed where the migration tests live — mgmt/backend/test/ following migration-matrix.test.mjs / h10-m38-indexes-and-retention.test.mjs patterns) that builds a fresh in-memory sqlite from ALL of mgmt/db/schema/*.sql, then asserts BEFORE applying seeds that the seed-bearing tables (journey_content, journey_page_text, donation_settings, consent_decline_templates — confirm exact table names by reading each seed migration) are EMPTY. This proves schema-only is half-empty.

Add a rebuild script under mgmt/db/ (e.g. mgmt/db/rebuild.mjs or extend migrate.mjs, following migrate.mjs's pure-logic/injected-exec style) that, given a target database, applies the schema then applies the four seed migrations (28,29,30,32) in order. Reuse migrate.mjs's declaredDatabases/loadMigrations helpers rather than re-deriving. Keep it non-destructive and idempotent where the underlying SQL is (the seed migrations must be safe to re-run — verify by reading them; if any is a bare INSERT that would duplicate on re-run, note it and have the runbook state the rebuild is for a FRESH database only).

Extend the proof test to also apply the seed migrations via the new path and assert the exact expected counts: journey_content = 12, journey_page_text = 2, donation_settings = 7, consent_decline_templates = 6. The test must FAIL if a seed migration is dropped from the rebuild path or a count drifts.

Add the missing §W8g rebuild section to DEPLOY_GUIDE.md: the exact ordered commands to rebuild a database from schema/ then seed it (schema apply, then the 28/29/30/32 seed apply), what row counts to expect, and the explicit warning that schema-only is half-empty (no donate bank/UPI details, declined-consent notifies nobody). Cross-reference migrate.mjs adopt/apply for the ledger.

Wire the new rebuild/seed proof test into CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml migrations job) so a future schema change that forgets a seed is caught. The migrations job already enforces 'every migration in every folder is covered by a test' — make sure the new test references the seed files by name so that guard stays satisfied.
Commit on a feature branch (e.g. wave-c-db-rebuild-readiness). Do NOT push.
acceptance_criteria: A new test builds fresh sqlite from mgmt/db/schema/*.sql and proves the four seed tables are empty schema-only, then proves the rebuild+seed path yields exactly 12/2/7/6 rows.
`cd mgmt/backend && npm test` (or the migrations test subset the CI migrations job runs) passes including the new test.
A runnable rebuild script exists under mgmt/db/ that applies schema then the 28/29/30/32 seeds for a given database.
DEPLOY_GUIDE.md contains a §W8g section with the exact rebuild+seed commands and expected row counts.
The CI migrations job references the new test and still passes its 'every migration covered' guard.
Mutation check: deleting one seed migration from the rebuild path, or corrupting an expected count, makes the new test fail (recorded in findings).
verification: Run the new rebuild script against a local/in-memory sqlite and confirm the four tables report 12/2/7/6 rows
findings:
BRANCH: wave-c-db-rebuild-readiness (off main @3cc8529). Commit cad5823.

BASELINE (house method step 1, at 3cc8529 before any change): `cd mgmt/backend && npm test` => 1045 pass / 0 fail. CI migrations subset (migration-matrix, migration-target-databases, pr34, pr35, h10-m38, h9) => 91 pass / 0 fail. Did NOT run full mgmt/frontend / SvelteKit / server-render builds for the baseline: this feature touches only mgmt/db + mgmt/backend/test + ci.yml + DEPLOY_GUIDE.md, none of which those builds cover; the backend suite and migrations subset are the gates for this change. server-render/svelte builds are gated by FEAT-002..005.

KEY DISCOVERY (important for the plan's wording): the plan named tables 'journey_content/journey_page_text/donation_settings/consent_decline_templates' but those are NOT real table names. The 12/2/7/6 figures are per-MIGRATION INSERT counts (verified: grep -c '^INSERT INTO' => 12/2/7/6). Actual target tables:
  - 28-journey-content.sql (chhath-core): 10 rows journey_entries + 2 rows portal_settings (tagline) = 12
  - 29-journey-page-text.sql (chhath-core): 2 rows portal_settings (JSON blobs) = 2
  - 30-donation-settings.sql (chhath-core): 7 rows portal_settings (donation_* keys) = 7
  - 32-consent-decline-templates.sql (chhath-loans-expenses): 4 rows loan_message_templates + 2 rows loan_email_templates = 6
Seed migrations span TWO databases (core + loans-expenses), not one. The test asserts per-migration row DELTAS across each migration's target tables (== INSERT counts 12/2/7/6), applied incrementally because 28/29/30 all share portal_settings. All four seeds are idempotent (every INSERT is WHERE NOT EXISTS; 32 also CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS for loan_email_templates), so `seed` is re-run safe; `full` (schema DDL is plain CREATE TABLE, no IF NOT EXISTS) is for a FRESH db only — documented in W8g and the script header.

DELIVERED:
  - mgmt/db/rebuild.mjs: pure-logic + injected-exec runner (reuses migrate.mjs loadMigrations/MIGRATION_ROOT). Commands plan/seed/full, --db/--local/--remote/--dry-run. Verified end-to-end against in-memory sqlite: chhath-core => journey_entries=10, portal_settings=11 (2+2+7); chhath-loans-expenses => loan_message_templates=4, loan_email_templates=2. `node mgmt/db/rebuild.mjs plan` output confirmed.
  - mgmt/backend/test/rebuild-and-seed.test.mjs: 6 tests. Proves schema-only leaves all four seed tables EMPTY (the half-empty defect), then rebuild+seed yields exactly 12/2/7/6; also full-rebuild-from-empty, idempotency, schema-before-seed ordering, and rebuildPlan shape. References 28/29/30/32 by name (CI 'every migration covered' guard stays satisfied — simulated the guard grep, ALL COVERED).
  - DEPLOY_GUIDE.md: added §W8g (Hinglish, matching house style) with plan/full/seed commands, the explicit half-empty warning (no donate bank/UPI; declined consent notifies nobody #349), verify commands expecting 12/2/7/6, and cross-ref to migrate.mjs adopt for the ledger.
  - .github/workflows/ci.yml: added test/rebuild-and-seed.test.mjs to the migrations job run list.

VERIFICATION AFTER CHANGE: `cd mgmt/backend && npm test` => 1051 pass / 0 fail. CI migrations subset + new test => 97 pass / 0 fail.

MUTATION TESTS (house method step 3, done AFTER commit cad5823, all reverted via git checkout):
  1. Dropped 30-donation-settings.sql from SEED_MIGRATIONS in rebuild.mjs => 2 tests FAILED (killed).
  2. Corrupted EXPECTED_SEED_ROWS 28 from 12 to 11 => 2 tests FAILED (killed).
  3. Reordered runRebuild to apply seeds before schema => 1 test FAILED (full-rebuild ordering guard, killed).
No surviving mutants. Tree restored to cad5823 (6/6 green) after each.

SCOPE: did not push / open PR (per constraints). Only FEAT-001 implemented.
